verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs say developers can call it from any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it at the local endpoint, and that it supports the Anthropic Messages API for Claude clients. The pack shows no LocalAI-published Python or JavaScript libraries, so language-library access comes only through third-party SDK compatibility. Missing for 10: first-party LocalAI client libraries, language-specific SDK docs or examples for Python/JavaScript, and independent hands-on confirmation that existing SDKs work without issues.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript

citations.quote: You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
LocalAI supports the Anthropic Messages API, which is compatible with Claude clients.
